LanguageData.AB_VerboseLoggingTip: Write detailed diagnostic messages to the log. Only useful when hunting a bug.
LanguageData.AB_NotLinkedLine: Not connected to another level yet.
LanguageData.AB_ViewOtherLevelDesc: Jump the camera to the connected stairwell on the other level. You can also press Page Up and Page Down to switch levels.
LanguageData.AB_BasementCreated: The basement level has been opened. It is solid rock, mine it out to expand.
LanguageData.AB_SkyCreated: The sky level has been opened. Build floors above roofed rooms to expand upward.
LanguageData.AB_OnlySurfaceForNow: Must be placed on the surface level.
LanguageData.AB_LevelCap: Level limit reached (one above, one below).
LanguageData.AB_ShowLiveBelow: Show live movement on the level below
LanguageData.AB_ShowLiveBelowTip: Draw pawns, animals, and projectiles from the level below when looking down through open air. Turn off if you want a small performance gain on the sky level.
LanguageData.AB_BelowDimTip: How much the view of the level below is darkened when seen from above.
LanguageData.AB_ClimbTimeTip: Multiplies how long every stairs type takes to climb. Ladders are slower and grand staircases faster than normal stairs regardless.
LanguageData.AB_ShowCeilingHint: Show ceiling hints on the surface
LanguageData.AB_ShowCeilingHintTip: Cells under a built sky level floor draw a faint ceiling texture, so you can tell there is a structure overhead while looking at the surface.
LanguageData.AB_StairsCollapsed: A stairwell lost its support and collapsed.
LanguageData.AB_DismountFirst: Dismount before using stairs or elevators.
LanguageData.AB_GoUpDesc: Take the nearest stairs to the level above.
LanguageData.AB_GoDownDesc: Take the nearest stairs to the level below.
LanguageData.AB_NoStairs: no linked stairs on this level
LanguageData.AB_LinkBlocked: The stairwell could not connect. The matching spot on the other level is blocked.
LanguageData.AB_BlockedOnTarget: The matching spot on the other level is blocked.
LanguageData.AB_NoSupportOnTarget: The matching spot on the other level cannot support a stairwell.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelWork: Colonists take stairs to work on other levels
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelWorkTip: When a colonist finds no work on their current level, they check directly linked levels and take the stairs if there is something to do there.
LanguageData.AB_IdleReturnHome: Idle colonists return to the surface
LanguageData.AB_IdleReturnHomeTip: Colonists with nothing to do on any level head back down to the surface instead of roaming the level they worked on.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelHaulingTip: When an item's best storage is on another level, haulers carry it through the stairs. Runs after normal hauling on the same level.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelNeeds: Colonists cross levels to sleep in their beds
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelNeedsTip: A tired colonist whose bed is on another level takes the stairs instead of sleeping on the ground.
LanguageData.AB_ExtendUpDesc: Extend the elevator shaft to the level above, opening it if needed, and place a linked car there.
LanguageData.AB_ExtendDownDesc: Extend the elevator shaft to the level below, opening it if needed, and place a linked car there.
LanguageData.AB_LevelWidgetTip: You can also press Page Up and Page Down.
LanguageData.AB_ShowLevelWidgetTip: Adds view level above and view level below buttons next to the other view toggles in the bottom right.
LanguageData.AB_PowerBridgeInspect: Power link: bridges the grid to the connected level.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelPipesTip: When pipes from Dubs Bad Hygiene or a Vanilla Expanded pipe network touch a linked stairwell on both levels, their stored contents flow between the levels. Power conduits connect through stairwells regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.AB_CrossLevelTemperatureTip: Linked stairwells slowly equalize temperature between the rooms they stand in, like a vent between floors. The sky level also follows the surface's outdoor temperature and seasons.
